review.note: M59: joined with british-raj, the same polity — the British Raj and British India are two English names for one polity. The outlines either side of the 1885/1886 seam share 95.18% of the smaller and 89.75% of the union (docs/m59-singletons.md), and that seam is where Historical Basemaps stops and CShapes 2.0 starts, not a date. The interval is now the 1885 record's own start (1878) and the 1886 record's own end (1947); neither was authored here.

summary: Entity 750 in the Gleditsch–Ward state list, as mapped by CShapes 2.0, a dataset of the borders and capitals of states and dependencies between 1886 and 2019. The dataset gives it 6 periods of territorial validity, from 1886 to 1947. The source calls it "India"; the names on this record are the ones data/imports/cshapes-actors.json gives it. Its last capital in the dataset is New Delhi (Delhi). The code is mapped onto more than one actor (data/imports/cshapes-actors.json); this record holds the periods before the first cut. This record was written by the import from those fields and asserts nothing the dataset does not.
